sources.note: K&M 210/9 data sheet, variant 21090-300-55 black (opened, text read, page rendered): height from 900 to 1,605 mm, boom arm length from 435 to 745 mm, 2-piece telescopic boom with T-bar locking screw, 2-piece folding rod with clutch, socket with foldable legs, steel, zinc die-cast base, 3/8 in threaded connector, 3.1 kg, size when folded 105 x 85 x 985 mm. The page has one product photo (stand, slight perspective) and no dimension drawing.

K&M product page for the 210/9 black (opened): same technical data as the data sheet (900-1,605 mm, boom 435-745 mm, folded 105 x 85 x 985 mm, 3.1 kg, 3/8 in thread). No base diameter, no tube diameters, no drawing: the 700 x 700 mm footprint is a photo estimate (leg tips about 650 mm apart in the data sheet photo, scaled on the 1,605 mm height), not a published figure.

The scripted model is read from this photo and the data sheet, ESTIMATES by us except the published figures (height 1605, boom 435 to 745 mm, 3/8 in thread, folded 105 x 85 x 985). Photo scale: the stand spans 1605 mm from the foot bottoms to the thread tip. From the photo: the clutch sleeve at 1028 to 1120 mm (64 to 70 % of the height), a stop collar about 105 mm under it, the pivot at about 1453 mm, the boom rising about 20 degrees to the front with the tip as the highest point, a rubber counterweight grip at the rear end, three clamps (two with thumbscrews), a conical hub with a wing screw, three round legs with rubber feet (about 34 mm). Estimated: tube diameters 21.8 mm lower and 19 mm upper, leg tube 16 mm, hub 88 mm, front arm 445 mm and rear arm 300 mm (445 + 300 = the 745 mm total), the 15 degree leg angle (it gives 700 mm along x and along z for the 418 mm leg radius that follows from the 700 x 700 footprint, itself a photo estimate), the boom over one leg. No logo, no lettering.
